senses.gloss: to generate smoke; to fumigate; to burn incense.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 23a:5">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> (ref. to the use of oil for ink) <he>לגבל או לעַשֵּׁן</he> do you mean for kneading it with soot, or for making soot by burning it? <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12:1">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite> <he>והיו מְעַשְּׁנוֹת לפני עכו״ם</he> they burnt incense before idols; Tanḥ. Tol’doth 8 <he>מעשנות ומקטרות וכ׳</he> raised smoke and burnt perfumes &c.

Yeb. 115ᵃ עִישֵּׁינוּ עלינו בית וכ׳ (Ar. עִישְּׁנוּ) they (robbers) filled our house with smoke, filled a cave in which we dwelt with smoke &c. Y. Ber. VI, 12ᵇ bot. במְעַשֵּׁין לפני וכ׳ (not במעשיו) when he burns spices in front of his shop; a. e.—Esp. to fumigate plants.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:2">Shebi. II, 2</cite> <he>מְעַשְּׁנִין עד וכ׳</he> you may fumigate until New Year (of the Sabbatical year). Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top <he>המְעַשֵּׁן</he> he who fumigates plants (on the Sabbath); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְעוּשָּׁן</he>; f. <he>מְעוּשֶּנֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְעוּשָּׁנִים</he>, <he>מְעוּשָּׁנִין</he>; <he>מְעוּשָּׁנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 8:6">Men. VIII, 6</cite> <he>אין מביאין … מע׳</he> you must not use for libations sweet wine or smoked wine (of fumigated grapes). Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ bot. <he>ענבים מאובקות ומע׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>מאונ׳</he>) powdered (v. <cite ref="A00189"><he>אָבַק</he></cite>) or smoked grapes should not be offered as first-fruits.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:5">Ḥull. III, 5</cite> <he>המע׳</he> an animal that has inhaled smoke; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be affected by smoke, taste of smoke.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 64a:8">Zeb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא יִתְעַשֵּׁנוּ</he> lest the wine for libations may catch smoke (when carried past the altar pyre).
